Summarize a diagnostic test

Source: R/dx_utils.R
summary.dx.Rd

Shows the formatted estimate and confidence interval of each measure in a dx object at one threshold.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dx'
summary(
  object,
  thresh = object$options$setthreshold,
  variable = NA,
  label = NA,
  show_var = TRUE,
  show_label = TRUE,
  measure = NA,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

An object of class "dx"

thresh

The threshold to show: setthreshold (default) or a value in threshold_range.

variable

Variables to include: "Overall" for all cases, or names in grouping_variables. Defaults to all.

label

Subgroups to include: levels of the grouping variables, or "Overall". Defaults to all.

show_var

Include the variable column?

show_label

Include the label (subgroup) column?

measure

Names of the measures to include, as in the measure column of as.data.frame.dx(), such as "Sensitivity". Defaults to all.

...

Not used.

Value

A table of the measures and their summaries at thresh, made with knitr::kable(). If knitr is not installed, a data frame.

Examples

dx_obj <- dx(
  data = dx_heart_failure,
  true_varname = "truth",
  pred_varname = "predicted",
  setthreshold = .3,
  grouping_variables = "Sex"
)
summary(dx_obj)
